name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
title: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd - 544913 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.

capex.quote: Next 8 months, we are looking at commissioning.

triggers.label: Order book Rs.982 cr, ~2x last year
triggers.quote: our order book as on 31st July is Rs.982 crores, which is the unexecuted order book that we that the company has on hand, and this is almost twice the revenue of last year.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth ~25%
triggers.quote: we are expecting around 25% growth on revenue, and EBITDA margins will be historically in the same range

triggers.label: No substantive new order in 3 months
triggers.quote: I don't think there's any order of substance that has come in the past three months.

EBITDAs are what we are aiming to deliver is around 23% to 25% EBITDAs and 18% to 20% PAT
